name: phpmyadmin
title: phpMyAdmin
author: yunix-intel
description:
龙芯版说明

架构：linux/loong64（仅龙芯 3A5000/3A6000）

与上游差异：此镜像为 LoongArch 适配构建；上游主要功能保留，但尚未逐项做行为回归，镜像说明中列出的限制同样适用。

缺失功能：未逐项验证上游全部功能；请以镜像说明中的限制为准。

额外依赖：无额外外部依赖（镜像说明中另有注明的除外）。

镜像说明：5.2.3；PHP 8.3 + nginx/php-fpm；无需数据库即可开登录页；8080
description_en:
LoongArch notes

Architecture: linux/loong64 only

Differences: LoongArch build; upstream functionality is largely retained, but behavior was not regression-tested item by item. Limitations in the image notes also apply.

Missing features: Upstream features were not verified item by item; treat the image notes as the limitation list.

Extra dependencies: No extra external dependency unless the image notes say otherwise.

Image notes: 5.2.3；PHP 8.3 + nginx/php-fpm；无需数据库即可开登录页；8080

manual: 在登录页填写外部 MySQL/MariaDB 主机、用户和密码
notes: 不内置数据库；PMA_ARBITRARY=1 允许连接任意服务器。
无 Dockerfile，端口/卷来自 docs/RUNBOOK.md 端口索引与人工核对。
未在 OpenWrt/iStoreOS 真机上执行安装回归；仅做 ipk 结构与 JSON schema 静态校验。
